_readme: Full transcription of 'APPENDIX A - Case Categorisation.pdf' (RFP 2026_028), a 6-column table:
Case Category | Case Division | Level 1 | Level 2 | Level 3 | Level 4.
Shape: a flat array of row objects, one per PDF table row (300 data rows, matching the
PDF's own row count 1:1) -- chosen over a nested tree because several rows repeat the
same (case_category, case_division, level_1) combination with a *different* level_2 (and
the tree isn't strictly a tree: level_1 'Refund' under Sales/Inquiry, for instance, carries
level_2='Booking' on three separate rows with three different level_3 values). A flat table
has no merge ambiguity and stays trivially diffable against the PDF for future re-checks.
Empty string '' means that column was blank on that row in the source PDF (not missing data).
Transcription notes:
- Multi-line PDF cells (word-wrap only, not client content) are joined with a single space,
e.g. 'No Estimated Time\nDelivery' -> 'No Estimated Time Delivery'.
- All other text, including the client's own typos and inconsistent capitalization, is
preserved byte-for-byte. Notable typos (kept as-is because client reports key off these
exact strings): 'Profesionalism' (Sale Specialist Profesionalism; Service Profesionalism),
'Innacurate' (Map Innacurate location; Innacurate location), 'Allignment' (Body/Exterior
only -- the Body/Interior and Steering/Suspension rows correctly say 'Alignment'),
'Electical phase' (Charging/Configuration), 'Order Synhcronization' (Apps/Vehicle Order
Issue), 'Charging abnormally Interupted' (Charging/Infotainment), 'Stock Availbility'
(After Sales/Spare Part, Inquiry), 'Home Assesment' (Charging/Refund, Inquiry -- note
'Assessment' IS spelled correctly elsewhere, e.g. Charging/Home Charging rows).
- Also present verbatim, not typos but genuine source inconsistencies: lowercase 'others'
vs 'Others' used interchangeably as a Level 2 value across rows; 'smart points' / 'smart
point charging' (lowercase, Apps/Charging divisions); 'Service/Recall Campaign' (no
spaces, under Complaint) vs 'Service / Recall Campaign' (spaces, under Inquiry) for the
same After Sales Level 1 concept; 'Unable to update.' (Apps Level 1, includes a literal
trailing period).
Source: docs/client-materials/RFP 2026_028/APPENDIX A - Case Categorisation.pdf (6 pages).
Extracted via pdfplumber table extraction, cross-checked against `pdftotext -layout` and a
manual visual read of each page. Row count sanity check: 3 Case Category values x 8 Case
Division values x (variable Level 1/2/3/4 depth) = 300 total data rows.
